draftBefore.emotion: warm and affectionate, the way one speaks of a beloved relative
notes: In Thai, family terms are very specific. 'ยาย' specifically refers to your mother's mother. Your father's mother is called 'ย่า' (yâa).
It is also common to use 'ยาย' as a polite or respectful term for any elderly woman, even if she is not related to you.
